title: Masters Student
summary: A two-year MSc project measuring sediment accretion and blue-carbon burial in restored mangrove plots.

add_paragraph: This MSc project sits within the coastal and mangrove workstream. You will help run the sediment-trap network in one of our three partner estuaries, process cores in the Oslo lab, and contribute to the annual blue-carbon accounting report.

We are looking for a student with a background in environmental science, geography or chemistry who is comfortable with fieldwork in a tropical coastal setting. Training in sediment analysis and R is provided.
